steps.en: Install the NetWasm templates and create a C# app
steps.zh: 装上 NetWasm 模板，用它建一个 C# 应用
steps.code: dotnet new install NetWasm.Templates · dotnet new netwasm-app -n HelloNetWasm

steps.en: Write ordinary C#, exactly like a console program
steps.zh: 写普通的 C#，和普通控制台程序一样

steps.en: Restore and publish with the same commands you already know
steps.zh: restore 并发布，用的还是熟悉的 dotnet 命令
steps.code: dotnet restore · dotnet publish -c Release -o publish/local

steps.en: Compiles reachable code to Wasm: drops unreachable parts, specializes generics, links the GC it needs
steps.zh: 把可达代码编成 Wasm：丢掉不可达、特化泛型、按需链接 GC

steps.en: Packages the result as one WASI Preview 2 component declaring its host capabilities
steps.zh: 把结果打包成 WASI P2 组件，声明所需宿主能力

steps.en: Run the file wherever a WASI host runs — no .NET needed on the target
steps.zh: 任何 WASI 宿主上直接运行，目标机器没有 .NET

value.en: One standalone .wasm file is the whole program — it runs with no .NET installed anywhere on the target
value.zh: 一个独立 .wasm 文件就是整个程序——目标机器不用装 .NET

sources: README.md Try it (dotnet new install NetWasm.Templates; dotnet new netwasm-app -n HelloNetWasm; dotnet restore; dotnet run; dotnet publish -c Release -o publish/local; wasmtime run publish/local/HelloNetWasm.wasm prints 42)
docs/sdk-quickstart.md sections 1-3 (same commands; first restore pulls pinned Node/wasm-ld/wasm-opt host-tools package)
docs/size-and-methodology.md (reference source Console.WriteLine(42); 84,513-byte Release component; runs under Wasmtime 47.0.3)
docs/ARCHITECTURE.md (closed-world reachability, generic specialization, WIT/WASI Preview 2 component packaging)
